title: Premium minimal portfolio thumbnails regeneration and wiring

requirements.summary: Regenerate three premium minimal 1200x900 portfolio thumbnails as new static assets with consistent style.
acceptanceCriteria: Three new/updated portfolio thumbnails exist as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated with the filenames specified in imageRequirements.edits targets.
Each image is 1200x900 and visually consistent with the site’s premium minimal aesthetic (clean, modern, minimal color, subtle lighting; no busy multicolor gradients).
The three images are distinct from one another (not duplicates) while still matching as a set.

requirements.summary: Update the Portfolio section to reference the newly generated portfolio thumbnail filenames for the three project cards only.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/marketing/PortfolioSection.tsx references the new portfolio image paths for the three projects.
Only the portfolio card images in the Portfolio section are changed; no other images/sections are modified.
The Portfolio section renders without broken images (no 404s) and the images maintain the existing aspect ratio and object-cover behavior.
